title: Tenant failover orchestrator: backpressure annealing patch and graceful cold-starts
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Stabilizes tenant failover behavior by annealing circuit-open thresholds and smoothing soft backpressure during region failover; mitigates oscillations and reduces cold-start latency for protected tenants.
description: Context and motivation: During last week's regional failover drill we observed repeated rapid open/close cycles of tenant-level circuit breakers when background traffic spiked while instances were cold. This caused latency spikes and increased error-profile churn for top-tier tenants. Root cause: a hard threshold for open/close plus aggressive immediate retry semantics combined with KV-cache reattachment delays. This PR introduces an annealing-based backpressure controller plus a short soft-warmup window to reduce oscillation and give KV/worker pools time to warm.
commits: 1) 7d3b9f5: backpressure/anneal controller implementation and config; 2) 2a1c4ef: introduce tenant_warmup_ms and soft-retry jitter; 3) 9c4e2bd: add metrics and tag enrichment (tenant_id, failover_wave); 4) 1b7f11a: e2e scenario test and deterministic seed; 5) 3f2a8de: bump default thresholds for Dedicated tier;
review_comments:
Diego Morales: 'This looks promising — could you add a rollout plan for Dedicated customers and note any config flags we should allow operators to tweak?'
Author (Ava): 'Added defaults.yaml and docs; Dedicated thresholds are in defaults and can be overridden via orchestrator.config. See rollout section in description.'
Priya Nair: 'Please add metric for 'anneal_phase' and ensure we don't increment tenant error budgets when circuit is intentionally annealing.'
Author: 'Added metric tag and adjusted SLO filter to ignore anneal windows.'
Ethan Brooks: 'Can we guard the new path under a feature flag until canary?'
Author: 'Added feature flag: orchestrator.enable_anneal (false in staging).'
qa_notes: Staging: ran integration scenario 3x with deterministic seeds, verified no circuit oscillation for 200 simulated tenants. Canary: deployed to us-west-2 with orchestrator.enable_anneal=true for 4% traffic for 24h then 25% for 48h. Observed 45% reduction in reopen events and 12% lower p95 for affected tenants.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge to main behind feature flag; 2) Canaries: 4% -> 25% -> 100% (72h between steps); 3) Monitor 'circuit_reopen', 'anneal_phase', tenant-error-budget-burning; 4) If reopen rate increases > 2x, rollback flag and revert patch; 5) Backport hotfix to release-2025.12 if customer impact observed.
testing: Unit tests for anneal math (deterministic); integration scenario simulating KV reattachment delays; e2e with synthetic tenants hitting scheduled failover windows; CI matrix covers Dedicated and Hosted profiles.
telemetry_queries: 1) SELECT rate(circuit_reopen[5m]) BY tenant WHERE anneal_phase='active'; 2) SELECT p95(latency) BY tenant WHERE anneal_phase='active' OR failover_region IS NOT NULL; 3) Alert: circuit_reopen_rate > baseline*2 for 30m
risk: Low-medium: behavioral change to circuit timing. Feature-flagged and configurable. Does not change API surface. Requires close monitoring of SLO filters to avoid masking true faults.
post_merge_actions: 1) Ramp canary as described; 2) Create a dashboard tile for 'anneal_phase' distribution across regions; 3) Add Linear tasks for backporting to last three release branches;
notes: Related to ENG-8742 (stability during regional failovers) and ENG-9021 (tenant cold-start pain points). Hotfix requested by Support ticket SUP-4432 for two affected enterprise customers in EMEA.
changelog_entry: Stabilize tenant failover handling: add annealing backpressure to avoid circuit oscillation; better warmup handling for KV attach during region failovers.
